intro: Moroccan culture blends Amazigh, Arab, African, Andalusian and French influences.

chapters.title: Crafts and music
text: Zellige tilework, leather tanneries in Fez and colourful souks are famous. Gnawa music, with roots in West Africa, is on UNESCO's list.

chapters.title: Food
text: Tagine, slow-cooked stew in a cone-lidded pot, and couscous on Fridays are classics. Sweet mint tea is poured from high above the glass.

keyTerms.meaning: A stew and the clay pot it is cooked in.
